item.text: {"search_note":"I found good evidence on social protection, education, health infrastructure, and water/sanitation.\nI did not find strong independent evidence on staffing inside the health or education ministries themselves, so the “competent professionals vs patronage networks” part is only partly observable.\nThe strongest positive evidence comes from IMF/World Bank program documents and official Egyptian statements, while the strongest negative evidence comes from Amnesty and HRW on access failures, especially for refugees.","evidence":[{"title":"IMF staff agreement on Egypt reviews under the EFF","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-03-06","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/03/06/pr-2459-egypt-staff-and-authorities-reach-agreement-on-reviews-under-the-eff-arrangement","summary":"The authorities agreed to more social spending for vulnerable groups and a larger cash-transfer package, which is direct evidence of social protection being funded through formal policy rather than pure patronage.","question_ids":["6B.4","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"World Bank: Promoting Inclusive Human Capital Development and Building Resilience in Egypt through Cash Transfer Programs","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-05-28","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2024/05/28/promoting-inclusive-human-capital-development-and-building-resilience-in-egypt-through-cash-transfer-programs","summary":"Takaful and Karama is described as institutionalized and well-targeted, tied to health, education, child nutrition, and women’s empowerment, with a 55 percent benefit increase. That is strong evidence of professionally managed social protection.","question_ids":["6B.4","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"IMF technical assistance report on public investment management","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-04-02","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/publications/technical-assistance-reports/issues/2024/04/02/arab-republic-of-egypt-technical-assistance-report-public-investment-management-assessment-547051","summary":"Egypt had taken steps to improve infrastructure access and public investment management, and the report specifically references Education 2.0 and health-infrastructure rollout. This supports a technocratic rather than patronage-driven management story.","question_ids":["6B.4","6B.2","5B.7"]},{"title":"World Bank Group statement of support to Egypt’s development and reform efforts","publisher":"World Bank Group","date":"2024-03-18","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/statement/2024/03/18/world-bank-group-statement-of-support-to-egypt-s-development-and-reform-efforts","summary":"The reform agenda was framed around inclusive growth, human capital, resilience, and protection of the poorest, which is consistent with social-service financing through policy institutions.","question_ids":["6B.4","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"New World Bank US$700 million support to help Egypt achieve more sustainable, diversified and resilient growth","publisher":"World Bank Group","date":"2024-06-24","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/24/new-world-bank-us-700-million-support-to-help-egypt-achieve-more-sustainable-diversified-and-resilient-growth","summary":"The package supported stronger SOE governance, competition policy, lower electricity-distribution losses, and water and sanitation sustainability. That is direct evidence of technically designed public-service improvement.","question_ids":["6B.4","6B.2"]},{"title":"President El-Sisi swears in new government ministers","publisher":"State Information Service","date":"2024-07-03","url":"https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/president-sisi-swears-in-new-government-ministers/","summary":"The reshuffle installed a broad cabinet with technocratic portfolios tied to economic management, energy, science, and foreign affairs. This is weaker than independent verification, but it is the clearest official signal that Sisi was trying to staff governance with experts.","question_ids":["6B.4","5B.7"]},{"title":"Minister: Labor ministry has strategy to empower women","publisher":"State Information Service","date":"2024-03-23","url":"https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/minister-labor-ministry-has-strategy-to-empower-women/","summary":"The labor ministry said women’s empowerment, training, job placement, and a gender-equality unit were priorities at Sisi’s direction. That suggests some professionalized social-policy design, though still official self-reporting.","question_ids":["6B.4","6B.3","6B.2"]},{"title":"Egypt: new law threatens to reduce access to healthcare for millions","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-07-30","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/egypt-new-law-threatens-to-reduce-access-to-healthcare-for-millions/","summary":"Amnesty said Law 87 of 2024 privatized management of public health facilities without price regulation and was rushed through without adequate consultation. This is strong contrary evidence that social services were not always protected by competent, access-focused administration.","question_ids":["6B.4","6B.2"]},{"title":"Egypt: Education Restricted for Refugees","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-12-02","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/egypt-education-restricted-for-refugees","summary":"HRW found tens of thousands of refugee and asylum-seeking children out of school because of residency rules, costs, discrimination, and limited free public education. That undercuts any broad claim of competent, equitable service delivery.","question_ids":["6B.4","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"Egypt: President al-Sisi must reject new asylum law which violates refugee rights","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-12-03","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/egypt-president-al-sisi-must-reject-new-asylum-law-which-violates-refugee-rights/","summary":"Amnesty said the asylum law restricted rights and failed to protect education, housing, and social security for refugees and asylum seekers. This is direct evidence against professionally managed, rights-preserving social administration for vulnerable groups.","question_ids":["6B.4","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"Egypt: Authorities must end campaign of mass arrests and forced returns of Sudanese refugees","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-06-19","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/egypt-authorities-must-end-campaign-of-mass-arrests-and-forced-returns-of-sudanese-refugees/","summary":"Mass arrests, cruel detention, and forced returns show that vulnerable populations were handled coercively rather than through competent welfare administration.","question_ids":["6B.4","6B.3","6B.2"]},{"title":"Human Rights Watch World Report 2024: Egypt","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/egypt","summary":"HRW said the June 2024 visa requirement made it harder for Sudanese women, children, and older people to flee conflict. That is negative evidence on whether the state managed vulnerable populations with care and professional competence.","question_ids":["6B.4","6B.3"]}]}
